# edh-zones-16 (Commander effort, lane edh-zones; test/cloud/edh-zones-16, golden edh-zones-16-review.json): choose land or nonland + reveal until a card of the chosen kind (also as the replacement of a draw), another player reveals until a permanent card that shares a card type and puts it onto the battlefield, X can't be greater than the number of players + reveal until X land cards, for each creature exiled this way its controller searches for a basic land card
Abundance
Abundant Harvest
Wild Magic Surge
Open the Way
Winds of Abandon
